title: Linear-probe training on residual-stream activations
boundary_note: Safety framing = training a deception-detection probe used as a runtime monitor (interpretability / monitoring). The task only trains a numpy logistic regression on activation arrays.

rubric.desc: load_activations casts dtypes and raises ValueError on non-0/1 labels or row mismatch
make_synthetic implemented (balanced, deterministic, separable, float32/int64)
train_test_split honours the seed (deterministic, disjoint, complete)
train_test_split is stratified by label as documented
Standardizer centres constant features instead of producing NaN
train_and_evaluate fits the Standardizer on the training split only
loss_and_grad does not regularise the bias
fit descends the gradient (sign bug) and separates separable data
predict uses >= threshold as documented
probe save/load round-trip implemented (float64 w, float b)
feature_importance returns top-|w| indices, ties by lower index
fit(patience=...) early stopping with held-out validation and best-weight restore
accuracy of empty input returns nan instead of raising
auroc implemented (rank-based, ties half credit, nan for one class)
cross_validate folds cover every row exactly once (remainder no longer dropped)
sigmoid (and so loss_and_grad / predict_proba) is numerically stable for large |z|: exact 0/1 limits, no overflow warnings
Standardizer.transform and train_and_evaluate do not modify the caller's float64 arrays in place
fit raises ValueError on labels other than 0/1 (e.g. -1/1 or 0/2); bool labels still work
fit raises ValueError for a negative learning rate or negative l2
train_test_split raises ValueError for test_frac outside [0, 1]
train_test_split raises ValueError when X and y have different numbers of rows
cross_validate raises ValueError for k < 2 or k > n (k = n still works)
accuracy raises ValueError on length mismatch instead of silently broadcasting a length-1 input
auroc raises ValueError when labels and scores differ in length
probe save writes to exactly the given path (numpy would append .npz), so load(path) round-trips
save_activations writes to exactly the given path so load_activations(path) round-trips
early stopping restores best weights even when epochs run out before patience triggers
refitting a probe resets val_history_ / best_epoch_ / val_idx_ / loss_history_ (no stale state)
fit(patience=...) raises ValueError when val_frac leaves an empty validation or training set
feature_importance(k<0) raises ValueError instead of slicing [: -1]; k=0 gives []
feature_importance returns a list of Python ints as its type hint says (CLI prints [1, 2, 3])
CLI on a missing input file exits non-zero with a message naming the file, not a traceback
feature_importance and save on an unfitted probe raise RuntimeError like decision_function
